name: First Contract
briefing: Varga, a smuggler, runs his business from the old boathouse. Slip in, take him down quietly and leave the way you came.

tips.text: Tap where you want to go; double tap to run, but guards hear running. The stairs here lead up to a dark loft.
Watch the guard's cone. Hide in the closet as he passes, or sneak up behind him and tap him to knock him out.
Dark rooms hide you. Tap Crouch to move silently, then open the door to the office.
The man in gold is Varga. Come up behind him and tap him. Then get back to the green exit.
